assessments_select_linked_professional.name: assessments_select_linked_professional
assessments_select_linked_professional.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.care_links cl
        where cl.patient_id = "assessments"."user_id"
          and cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
          and cl.ended_at is null
          and (cl.shares_history or "assessments"."completed_at" >= cl.started_at)
      )

care_links_insert_by_patient.name: care_links_insert_by_patient
care_links_insert_by_patient.withCheck:
"care_links"."patient_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and "care_links"."ended_at" is null
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.invitations i
          where i.id = "care_links"."invitation_id"
            and i.patient_id = (select auth.uid())
            and i.professional_id = "care_links"."professional_id"
            and i.status = 'accepted'
        )

care_links_end_by_participant.name: care_links_end_by_participant
care_links_end_by_participant.using: ("care_links"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid()) or "care_links"."patient_id" = (select auth.uid())) and "care_links"."ended_at" is null
care_links_end_by_participant.withCheck: ("care_links"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid()) or "care_links"."patient_id" = (select auth.uid())) and "care_links"."ended_at" is not null

check_ins_select_linked_professional.name: check_ins_select_linked_professional
check_ins_select_linked_professional.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.care_links cl
        where cl.patient_id = "check_ins"."user_id"
          and cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
          and cl.ended_at is null
          and (cl.shares_history or "check_ins"."recorded_at" >= cl.started_at)
      )

insights_select_linked_professional.name: insights_select_linked_professional
insights_select_linked_professional.using:
"insights"."audience" = 'professional'
        and "insights"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.care_links cl
          where cl.patient_id = "insights"."patient_id"
            and cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
            and cl.ended_at is null
        )

invitations_insert_verified_professional.name: invitations_insert_verified_professional
invitations_insert_verified_professional.withCheck:
"invitations"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and "invitations"."patient_id" is null
        and "invitations"."status" = 'pending'
        and public.is_verified_professional()

journal_access_log_select_participants.name: journal_access_log_select_participants
journal_access_log_select_participants.using:
"journal_access_log"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid()) or exists (
        select 1 from public.journal_shares s
        where s.id = "journal_access_log"."share_id" and s.patient_id = (select auth.uid())
      )

journal_access_log_insert_by_professiona.name: journal_access_log_insert_by_professional
journal_access_log_insert_by_professiona.withCheck:
"journal_access_log"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.journal_shares s
          where s.id = "journal_access_log"."share_id"
            and s.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
            and s.revoked_at is null
            and (s.expires_at is null or s.expires_at > now())
        )

journal_share_entries_select_participant.name: journal_share_entries_select_participants
journal_share_entries_select_participant.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.journal_shares s
        where s.id = "journal_share_entries"."share_id"
          and (s.patient_id = (select auth.uid()) or s.professional_id = (select auth.uid()))
      )

journal_share_entries_insert_by_patient.name: journal_share_entries_insert_by_patient
journal_share_entries_insert_by_patient.withCheck:
exists (
          select 1 from public.journal_shares s
          where s.id = "journal_share_entries"."share_id" and s.patient_id = (select auth.uid()) and s.scope = 'entries'
        )
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.journal_entries e
          where e.id = "journal_share_entries"."entry_id" and e.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        )

journal_shares_insert_by_patient.name: journal_shares_insert_by_patient
journal_shares_insert_by_patient.withCheck:
"journal_shares"."patient_id" = (select auth.uid())
        and "journal_shares"."revoked_at" is null
        and exists (
          select 1 from public.care_links cl
          where cl.id = "journal_shares"."care_link_id"
            and cl.patient_id = (select auth.uid())
            and cl.professional_id = "journal_shares"."professional_id"
            and cl.ended_at is null
        )

professional_alerts_select_own_link.name: professional_alerts_select_own_link
professional_alerts_select_own_link.using:
"professional_alerts"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (
  select 1 from public.care_links cl
  where cl.id = "professional_alerts"."care_link_id"
    and cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
    and cl.ended_at is null
)

professional_alerts_update_open_own_link.name: professional_alerts_update_open_own_link
professional_alerts_update_open_own_link.using:
"professional_alerts"."professional_id" = (select auth.uid()) and "professional_alerts"."resolved_at" is null and exists (
  select 1 from public.care_links cl
  where cl.id = "professional_alerts"."care_link_id"
    and cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
    and cl.ended_at is null
)

professional_profiles_select_by_invited_.name: professional_profiles_select_by_invited_patients
professional_profiles_select_by_invited_.using:
exists (select 1 from public.invitations i where i.professional_id = "professional_profiles"."user_id" and i.patient_id = (select auth.uid()))
        or exists (select 1 from public.care_links cl where cl.professional_id = "professional_profiles"."user_id" and cl.patient_id = (select auth.uid()))

profiles_select_linked_professional.name: profiles_select_linked_professional
profiles_select_linked_professional.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.care_links cl
        where cl.patient_id = "profiles"."id"
          and cl.professional_id = (select auth.uid())
          and cl.ended_at is null
      )
